hypothesis: The repeated state/location fiction is an excessive response prior in the current SFT; reducing its TRAIN-only contribution while retaining every human/curated original row and adding source-grounded Latin American conversation may improve current-request following. This is a curriculum bundle, not an isolated causal attribution.
observedDevelopmentFailure: Snapshot4096 gives location-pattern answers (e.g. El cine se encuentra en la ocho...) across unrelated requests/corrections; these exposed cases remain development.

selection.ranking: SHA256 of fixed seed + templateId + groupId
selection.allOtherPriorRows: retained byte-for-byte and in original order
selection.priorValidation: all 1704 rows retained byte-for-byte with original folds

regional.targets: deterministic project-programmatic synthetic; source senses and usage; not human or UNIDAD output
regional.guard: only genuinely polysemic/context-dependent terms request clarification; no generic geography-to-meaning mapping; qualifying regional/usage notes retained

control: natural-control output shares old TRAIN selection and old complete VAL; LATAM variant adds only source-grounded regional SFT

successCriteria.development: Actual-history same ConversationEngine generation; reduce inappropriate location-pattern responses and improve request/correction/role handling against current own checkpoint; preserve old evidence. No acceptance from NLL.
successCriteria.finalAcceptance: Fixed candidate/config on fresh reserved suite: >=36/40 complete, >=8/10 fully correct dialogs, 0 critical/technical failures. Test not used for selection.
successCriteria.comparisonLimit: Training stage and new data jointly change; do not claim isolated proportional effect without matched control training.

activeTraining: No modification to active run corpus/config/model/core sources. Future stages only.

arms.sameParent: selected own SFT-v1 best; neither arm uses the other arm as parent
arms.validation: control keeps old1704; treatment adds regional VAL. Internal NLLs across arms not comparable. Compare same frozen external development40 actual-history cases.
arms.contentOnlyHash: sorted compact UTF8 JSON messages followed by LF, across exact retained order
arms.sourceLexicalFamilyGuard: Malformed pronunciation/citation-derived family excluded from synthetic only, not reassigned; frozen source remains immutable.
